item: V. bicolor records removed from V. aestivalis (87; 3 spellings of the name)
review: Unclear: agree to remove from V. aestivalis species level, but perhaps treat as counterpart to var. bicolor. 'If we are recognizing var. bicolor as distinct, why not move these records to var. bicolor?'
proposal: Add 'Vitis bicolor' to the include list of V. aestivalis var. bicolor (the V. aestivalis model pools the varieties, so the records reach the species model through the variety). 13 of the 87 have coordinates.

item: V. argentifolia additions to V. aestivalis var. bicolor (9)
review: Unclear: remove from var. bicolor and perhaps add to V. aestivalis at the species level to be safe; otherwise each specimen would need checking.
proposal: Remove 'Vitis argentifolia' and 'Vitis aestivalis var. argentifolia' from the var. bicolor include list; they stay on the V. aestivalis include list (already there). Note the tension with the item above: var. bicolor gains V. bicolor but loses V. argentifolia (FNA lists var. argentifolia under V. aestivalis).

item: V. odoratissima records removed from V. riparia (6)
review: Unclear: potentially okay to include but without spatial data it doesn't seem to matter.
proposal: Leave out. None has coordinates, so they would change the record count only.

item: V. rufotomentosa addition with no data (1, DEU456)
proposal: Keep as it stands (no coordinates; no effect on the model).
